title: Sceliph bounded AssemblyIR primary form recipe
description: Independent recipe version 0.1. Existing AssemblyIR remains morphloom.assembly/0.1; no IR migration is needed. Future/unknown versions, fields and operations fail atomically. Fingerprint is existing canonical fingerprintAssemblyIR SHA256, not raw file SHA. Local primitive semi-axes use mm, before existing rotation/scale. Mapping, geometry, clipping, topology, connectivity and resource constraints also apply at runtime.
